crossRefs.note: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house…
Write also to the Jews, as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which…
Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen…
Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

people.name: Agag
people.line: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Hammedatha
people.line: The father of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.

translations.web: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.
translations.bsb: So the king removed the signet ring from his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.
translations.kjv: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.
translations.asv: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.
